title: AI's Data Dilemma: Power and Resources

scenes.text: AI development consumes vast amounts of energy and resources!
Training AI models requires extensive computational power, increasing energy demands.
Handling large datasets requires significant storage, adding to environmental concerns.
Sustainable practices in AI must be prioritized to minimize environmental impact.
